303)༄༅/sems bskyed pa ni/chos thams cad la gnas pa'i 'du shes bskyed nas 'gro ba mtha' dag dang khyad par gang gi don du bya ba de la byams snying rje byang

tei:div.tei:p: sems bskyed pa ni/ chos thams cad la gnas pa'i 'du shes bskyed nas 'gro ba mtha' dag dang khyad par gang gi don du bya ba de la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems yun ring du sgom la/ ngo mtshar chen po grangs med pa'i brtson 'grus dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gis sems can thams cad dbugs dbyung ngo*/ 'khor ba'i gcong rong chen po las bsgral bar bgyi'o/ phas kyi rgol ba bdud dang log 'dren thams cad pham par bgyi'o/ mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pas bsnyogs pa thams cad bsal bar bgyi'o/ nga rgyal gyi ri bo bsnyil bar bgyi'o/ skye bo'i ljon shing rtsad nas gcod do/ chi bdag gi nyi ma phye mar rlog go/ ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal bar bgyi'o/ ma dad pa dang phyi rol pa dag dang lta ba phyin ci log pa dag yang dag pa'i lta ba la gzud cing dad par bgyi'o/ las kyi chu bo bzlog par bgyi'o/ srid pa'i rgya 304)mtsho skem par bgyi'o/ chos kyi sgron me sbar bar bgyi'o/ byang chub kyi lam bstan par bgyi'o/ bzod pa dang nges pa la gzud do/ bsam gtan gyi bde ba rtser stsal to/ 'dod chags kyi me dpung zhi bar bgyi'o/ zhe sdang gi mtshon rnon po gzhom par bgyi'o/ bde ba la gzud do/ phrag dog gi 'tshub ma zhi bar bgyi'o/ ser sna'i mdud pa grol bar bgyi'o/ sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar bgyi'o/ 'jigs pa ma mchis pa dang bde ba chen po'i grong khyer du 'jug cing gnas par bgyi'o/ de bas na bdag la las kyi dngos grub kyi mchog stsol zhing gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol zhing me tog 'thor ro// 305)༄༅/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po legs ldan tshogs kyi bdag po'i gsang sgrub dngos grub 'byung gter gyi bsnyen sgrub bya tshul rig 'dzin dgyes pa'i zhal lung bzhugs/ na mo gu ru badz+ra dhā ra ye/ he ru ka yi sgyu 'phrul las// gzung 'dzin ru tra bsgral nas kyang*// bstan srung ma hā kā la zhes// mnga' gsol mgon des shis pa stsol/

thog mar sa chog gi dod du/ cha gsum gser skyems rgyas par btang*/ rgyal chen tho 'dzug rtsa gsum sgrub khog spyi chings lta bu sbyor dgos kyang sgrub chen gzhan dang lhan du 'don skabs ma byas kyang rung*/ rten dang yo byad rnams gzhung gsal 'dzoms par byas nas/ dngos gzhi la/ hrīḥsngon= dngos grub 'byung gter gyi/ dug phyung*/ khrus gsol/ na mo bka' gcog= sogs mchod pa byin rlabs/ spos phyung*/ gur drag las byang gi skyabs sems/ tshogs bsags/ dkar gtor/ bgegs gtor rnams rnying sngon dang sbrel nas/ 306) las byang gi bka' bsgo nas/ bstod bshags/ 'dzab bzlas/ bsnyen bstod/ lus dkyil/ phur mjug nas/ seng gdong yan/ ma ning las byang bsnyen bstod yan grub mtshams/ dngos grub 'byung gter gyi/ swa bha ba= mdun gyi gtor ma mi dmigs pa'i= sogs nas/ rten bskyed/ snyan gsan/ spyan 'dren/ byin rlabs/ phyag 'tshal/ mchod pa/ smon lam/ ye dharma= yan/ gsol 'debs/ bsnyen dmigs/ yi dam sngags la/ shrī ma hā= sbrel pa nyer gcig tsam/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭaḥ 'di 'bum nyer lnga 'gro dgos kyang thun re la khri tsho tsam/ de dang*/ ma hā kā la sid+dhi yaṃ du dzaḥ sbrel pa brgya/ yum sngags brgya gzhung du gsal ba de gsum sbrel ba brgya tsam/ sngags 'grigs gsum gsum/ thun sngags lan cig sngags 'bul/ 'dod gsol le tshan/ bstod pa/ hūm̐/ bskal pa me ltar= bshags pa le tshan/ smon lam bcas so/ thun gnyis pa de ltar 'phros/ mdung 'dzin nas/ klu rgyal yan gsol ka tshang ma/ thun gsum 307) pa dngos grub 'byung gter sngar ltar/ gur drag tshogs skong*/ ma ning gsol ka dam brdar thugs lcags bskang gso bcas sbrel ma/ mgon po'i skong ba/ ma mo'i gsol ka gza' skong*/ dam can gsol ring*/ gur drag tshogs bsgral bstab/ drang lhag bcas/ thun bzhi pa dngos grub 'byung gter sngar bzhin/ nub mo/ bsnyen bstod/ dkar gtor/

rtsa rgyud/ gur drag chad bstan/ bro/ tshe 'gugs man mtha' bsdu/ nyin bzhi la de ltar/ nyin lnga pa drug pa la/ sngar ltar dngos sgrub 'byung gter thun dang po'i bsnyen bstod/ bskal pa me ltar yan grub mtshams/ gsol ka 'phros rnams dang*/ gur drag tshogs/ bskang ba/ chos skyong bskang ba rnams 'phros/ bar bshags tshar rjes/ dngos grub 'byung gter gyi/ mdun du e nag po= ling ga la bstim par gyur/ dgu rdung gis/ hūm̐/ bskal pa me ltar= rnga bkyags bcas/ sangs kyi 308)bka' bden pa= sogs/ 'gugs pa gsum/ bden chung dgu/ rtsa brgyud gsum/ gur drag gi/ hūm̐ drag po'i lha tshogs bden pa'i= gaṇ+ḍe ho/ bar 'og gi oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ga na gu ti/ sogs gnad dbab sngags brgya/ bdag he ru ka'i= e'i nang gi gzugs la thim/ hūm̐/ kha kha mu kha= oṃ pa na mu rbad= sogs/ phyes shig phyes shig bar nyer gcig gong gi dgra bo 'di'i rgyab rten byed pa'i= las kyi ling ga 'di la bstim cig rgyob sod dgu rdung*/ 'og gi bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer tsha la= yang yang bstim/ rbad sngags sum brgya tsam/ 'di khyon 'bum ther gcig 'gro dgos/ sngags tshar gcig rnga 'don/ rgyob sod dgu rdung*/ gur drag tshogs bsgral/ dngos grub 'byung gter/ dam nyams pa'i dgra bo sgrol pa'i sa 'di ni= da lta nyid du sod cig sgrol cig rgyob sod dgu rdung*/ gur drag zhal bstab/ dngos grub 'byung gter/ 309)bstan dgra gnod byed sdig po che 'di'i= nan dzaḥdzaḥ bar/ rgyob sod dgu rdung*/ thun gnyis pa la/ mdun du e nag po= nas/ zhal bstab yan 'don lugs gong ltar/ thun gsum pa de bzhin/ thun bzhi pa de ltar rjes/ drang lhag dkar gtor/ rtsa rgyud man sngar ltar ro/ nyin bdun pa la/ thun dang po'i rbad sngags yan sngar ltar la/ mgon po'i sku stod zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa= sogs nas mar 'gres/ sku gsung thugs phur/ 'bod rbad bsad gsum gcig dril gsum/

gru gsum nang du= 'khor bar bsam/ bdag dang mdun skyed= nag thum gyis bsad par bsam/ bsad sngags sum brgya tsam/ bdag nyid yi dam lha yi= brlag par bsam/ 'ur dgu brdung*/ hūm̐/ mgon po chen po'i= rnga bkyags dgra chos ltar/ bswo bing hri li li sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ rgyob sod bsad dung cha ya ma/ bsad sngags nyer gcig tsam/ mdun gyi ma 310)ma hā kā la'i= rus pa 'chos par bsam/ thun sngags/ nyer gcig tsam/ gur drag tshogs bsgral/ dam nyams pa'i dgra bo= bsad rdung cha gnyis ma/ gur drag zhal bstab/ bstan dgra gnod byed= rgyob sod dgu rdung*/ slar bzlog pa/ 'ur dgu rdung gis/ hūm̐/ byang shar mtshams kyi phar mtha'= sogs/ bzlog rdung rnga bkyags bcas/ tshar nyer gcig tsam/ gur drag drang ba/ lhag ma/ do nub sbyin sreg rdzas rnams snga tshags kyis/ dngos grub 'byung gter gyi mchod pa byin rlabs/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ badz+ra dz+wa la swa bha ba/ gtor ma mi dmigs pa= sngags drug phyag drug lha rdzas las grub pa'i= ma hā ba ling+ta te dz+wa= lan bdun bar/ me sbar la/ phaṭaḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas= mtshams bcad/ me lha bskyed pa/ spyan 'dren/ bzhugs gsol/ phyag 'tshal/ rnam lnga/ sman rag gtor chung*/ bsreg rdzas 'bul ba/ phrin las mdzod/ bar/ ag+ne de wa dgra bgegs kyi 311)sha khrag la khā hi/ lan bdun tsam/ bstod pa/ me lha mer gyur par bsam/ me dpung de'i nang du rang nyid he ru ka'i thugs ka nas traṃ cig 'phros pa las/ rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa'i ri rab= sogs nas/ spyan ras gzigs dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pas dbu rgyan par bsam/ mchod pa/ hūm̐/ dpal ldan mgon po mthu chen= sogs/ sha khrag rus gsum la kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bar/ hūm̐/ lha min dmag tshogs g.yul zlog= sogs nas/ zhabs la spyi bos gtug gyur cig bar dang*/ mar khu lan gsum/ de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul/ mthar mar khu lan gsum 'bul zhing*/ 'bod rbad bsad gsum/ dz+wa la ram̐= sbyar ba gzhung gsal/

nyer gcig byang shar pha mtha'i 'go hūm̐/ mgon po chen po'i thugs dam= nas/ nri rbad dzaḥ bar/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la badz+ra yak+sha 312)be ta li na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo= sogs nas/ phrin las mdzod cig bar/ las byang gi mchod pa ltar dang*/ 'og gi bsnyen pa'i bstod pa/ hūm̐/ bskal pa med ltar 'bar ba'i= nas/ bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ bar/ sbyin sreg ga ི bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ nag po chen po= mdzod cig yig brgya gsum/ oṃ ma hā kā la sarba muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ hūm̐/ ces pa dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o/ slar yang me lha sngar ltar gsal ba la/ gong gi hūm̐/ mchod yon me tog= nas/ las kun mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ yig brgya lan gcig oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ badz+ra muḥ hūm̐/ bdag gis mgon po khyed bsgrubs byin rlabs= sogs/ las kyi don rtogs 'gro ba'i mgon gyur shog dang*/ 313)gnas 'dir nyin mo bde legs= sogs brjod/ nub mo byang shar phar mtha' tshar grangs/ dkar gtor/ rtsa rgyud man sngar ltar/ grol nyin snga lang gis/ gur drag bsnyen bstod yan/ gsol ka rat+na'i sde bdun tsam/ dngos grub 'byung gtor bsnyen bstod yan/ gur drag tshogs bskang gzhung rgyug mdun du e nag po= nas/ zhal bstab yan sngags nyung tsam/ 'don lugs kha sang ltar/ drang ba/ lhag ma/ byang shar pha mtha' tshar ya zung 'phros/ dkar gtor/ sgo dbye/ 'byung gter 'phros/ kyai/ shar phyogs dri za'i= zhi zhi sa ma ya/ bar/ 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs zhi ba'i= sogs kyis/ dngos grub len/ gtor lha ye shes pa rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar be ga kra ma yaṃ/ gtor snod bhan+dha= rtsa brgyud/ gur drag bskul pa/ rnam rgyal 'bar ma/ ma ning bskul pa/ mgon po'i las rbad/ 'byung gter gsham nas/ mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi phrin las sna tshogs kyis dgra bgegs rdul du brlag par

bsam/ 314)bswo cha'o cha'o= nas sa ma ya dza bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo/ bar/ ma mo'i bskul/ gza' bskul/ dam can bskul/ phyi sgo gser skyems/ dkar gtor/ ye thog ra dge nang du gur drag chad tho/ zor 'phen sar/ dkar gtor/ za lam/ 'byung gter gyi zor lam phye ba/ hūm̐/ bla med dkon mchog gsum po= sogs nas/ byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa'i steng du bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog bar/ mdun du e nag po= sogs grub bskyed/ 'gugs pa gsum/ bden chung dgu rtsa rgyud gsum/ phur thun tshams bskul/ 'byung gter zor/ kyai/ bla med dkon mchog gzu dang dpang*/ nas/ bswo cha'o cha'o legs ldan nag po= bsgyur cig zlog cig bar/ bsad rdung cha gnyis ma/ jo dung dmod 'don/ bzhes dung lan gsum/ dgra bo las kyi ling thob/ lhag chen rdung*/ ā ka ro= gur drag brtan ma/ bro mnan/ bdag cag mchog grub= bcas/ mnan pa byed par/ dkar gtor/ mdun du e nag po= 'gugs pa gsum/ 315) bden chung dgu/ rtsa rgyud gsum/ dgra bo 'di'i rgyab rten byed pa'i lha dang phyes= sogs/ bstim shig phun thun tshom bskur/ dam nyams pa'i dgra bo sgrol ba'i sa 'di ni= nas/ sgrol cig bar/ badz+ra pa ṇi ma ma rak+ṣa/ gsum/ bstan dgra gnod byed sdig po che 'di'i= nan dzaḥdzaḥ gur drag bro mnan/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba= sogs brjod/ nang du log nas/ tshe 'gugs man mthar dbyungs/ rgyun du 'gro ba 'dren pa'i spyod lam bya'o/ mthar/ sngar rgyal tho btsugs yod na/ tho bsdu rtsa gsum sgrub khog ltar byas rjes/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor= bzang spyod sogs bya'o// sang nyin/ gur drag las byang*/ gsol ka rgyas bsdus ci mos/ tshogs bskang lhag ma yan tshar nas/ khang steng du dngos grub 'byung gter bsnyen bstod bshags pa yan grub mtshams/ dgra lha bcu gsum ma tshar grangs ci nus rjes/ mgon po 316)'khor bcas mchod pas mnyes nas ci bcol pa'i phrin las sgrubs par

bsam/ rol bsu/ 'ur sum rdung*/ ho/ ye shes kyi mgon po rnam par snang mdzad= gtang rag btang ngo*/ 'og ma la mchod rol/ mgon po khyed rnams kyis= nas/ phrin las grub par mdzod cig mchod rol/ gang zhig yid la= lan gsum/ gang zhig= rnga rdung*/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ar+ghaṃ= 'ur dgu rdung*/ hūm̐/ bde gshegs mgon po= dpal gyi tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ dgu rdung gsum/ hūm̐/ bdag gis mgon po khyed bsgrub= mgon gyur shog 'ur sum rdung*/ nang du log nas/ dkar gtor rtsa rgyud man mthar dbyung bas legs par grub bo// bstan srung yongs kyi rgyal po che// legs ldan nag po tshogs kyi bdag /'di bsgrubs dge bas mdo sgyu sems// bstan pa dar zhing rgyas gyur cig zhes pa'ang tshe dbang ngor pad+ma ma ṇis bris pa dge legs 'phel// maṅga lam//
